title.original: Mnemosyne: An Unsupervised, Human-Inspired Long-Term Memory Architecture for Edge-Based LLMs
title.zh: Mnemosyne：面向边缘 LLM 的无监督类人长期记忆架构
title.en: Mnemosyne: An Unsupervised, Human-Inspired Long-Term Memory Architecture for Edge-Based LLMs

inclusion_reason.zh: Mnemosyne 将图存储、提交/剪枝、概率召回和核心摘要组合为可移植的边缘长期记忆架构。
inclusion_reason.en: Mnemosyne combines graph storage, commit/prune operations, probabilistic recall, and a core summary into a portable edge-memory architecture.

abstract.zh: Mnemosyne 是为边缘 LLM 设计的无监督长期记忆架构，使用图存储、内容/冗余过滤、提交与剪枝，以及带时间衰减和刷新机制的概率召回。它还从固定长度记忆子图生成核心摘要，用于保留用户人格和长期领域信息。
abstract.en: Mnemosyne is an unsupervised long-term memory architecture for edge LLMs, combining graph storage, substance and redundancy filters, commit/prune operations, and probabilistic recall with temporal decay and refresh. A fixed-size memory subgraph also yields a concentrated core summary of persistent user traits.

problem.zh: 扩大上下文成本过高，静态 RAG 在边缘设备上又难区分语义相似但时间不同的重复对话，长期交互容易丢失时间关系与人格连续性。
problem.en: Brute-force context is too costly on edge devices, while static RAG struggles with repetitive, semantically similar but temporally distinct dialogue, losing chronology and user continuity.

approach.zh: 系统无监督过滤并提交新记忆到图中，按冗余和时间规律剪枝，召回时结合相关性、衰减与刷新概率，同时从局部图浓缩稳定核心信息。
approach.en: The system filters and commits new memories to a graph without supervision, prunes by redundancy and temporal rules, recalls with relevance/decay/refresh probabilities, and distills stable core information from a bounded subgraph.

system_design.zh: Mnemosyne 的写路径包含内容过滤、冗余判断、图提交和剪枝，读路径执行概率召回并更新访问状态；核心摘要作为有限边缘预算下的长期人物/领域缓存。
system_design.en: Mnemosyne's write path filters content, detects redundancy, commits graph state, and prunes; its read path performs probabilistic recall and refreshes access state, with a core summary serving as a bounded persistent cache.

key_results.zh: 纵向医疗对话盲评与 LoCoMo 结果显示，Mnemosyne 在真实感、长期记忆、时间推理和单跳召回上优于多种同骨干方法，并可在边缘约束下运行。
key_results.en: Blind longitudinal-healthcare evaluation and LoCoMo results report stronger realism, long-term memory, temporal reasoning, and single-hop recall than several same-backbone methods under edge-compatible constraints.

limitations.zh: 医疗对话和人格连续性是主要场景，概率衰减可能误删低频但关键事实；核心摘要的偏差、隐私删除与跨设备同步未在摘要中展开。
limitations.en: Evidence centers on healthcare dialogue and personal continuity; probabilistic decay may remove rare but important facts, while core-summary bias, privacy deletion, and device synchronization are not detailed.

notes.zh: 医疗对话、LoCoMo、边缘目标、具名基线和三项结果来自官方摘要；模型/设备名称、样本量及分项得分待全文审计。
notes.en: Healthcare dialogue, LoCoMo, edge scope, named baselines, and three results come from the official abstract; model/device names, sample size, and component scores await full-text audit.
